gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Malignant Glioma; Recurrent Glioblastoma; Recurrent Malignant Glioma; Recurrent Grade III Glioma; Grade III Glioma

Participants with recurrent or progressive high-grade gliomas (HGG) (World Health Organization (WHO) grade III or grade IV) who are candidates for surgical tumor debulking will be enrolled in this trial

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase I trial studies the side effects of nivolumab before and after surgery in treating children and young adults with high grade glioma that has come back (recurrent) or is increasing in scope or severity (progressive).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Have evidence of recurrence or progression of disease by MRI scan

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To measure the relative changes in cell cycle-related genetic signature of the tumor microenvironment post administration of neoadjuvant nivolumab in children and young adults with recurrent or progressive HGG when compared to a cohort of archived non-treated recurrent pediatric HGG samples.
To measure TIL density post administration of neoadjuvant nivolumab in children and young adults with recurrent or progressive HGG.
Blood samples will be obtained as pharmacodynamic markers throughout the study (Day 1 of every other cycle).

role_evidence.quote: NEOADJUVANT: Patients receive nivolumab IV over 30 minutes 14 days before undergoing standard of care surgical resection.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy with monoclonal antibodies, such as nivolumab, may help the body's immune system attack the cancer, and may interfere with the ability of tumor cells to grow and spread.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: cell cycle-related gene expression signature (tumour microenvironment)

source_quote.quote: Will assess the percentage change in cell cycle-related genetic signature post administration of neoadjuvant treatments when compared to archived recurrent pediatric HGG group.

To measure relative changes in interferon gamma associated genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment post administration of neoadjuvant nivolumab in children and young adults with recurrent or progressive HGG compared to archived non-treated recurrent pediatric HGG samples.
To measure PD-1 and PDL-1 expression by immunohistochemistry for children and young adults with recurrent or progressive HGG post neoadjuvant nivolumab

To explore the correlation of tumor mutational load with clinical response for children and young adults with recurrent or progressive HGG treated with neoadjuvant nivolumab followed by adjuvant nivolumab.

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult HGG trial (>6 months to <25 years; stdAges CHILD, ADULT). Glioblastoma named in conditions; eligibility allows WHO grade III or IV HGG without IDH requirement, hence historical terminology. Interferon-gamma and cell-cycle signatures, TIL density and PD-L1 coded as tumour pharmacodynamic markers for nivolumab; none is an eligibility/enrichment biomarker. TMB coded exploratory correlative; matched=false as it is a response correlate rather than a mechanistic target (adjudicator may differ). Pre-surgical plasma samples mentioned without stated drug-level purpose; no tumour/CSF PK. Quality-of-life and questionnaire interventions are not agents.
